acceptedHighFindings.rationale: Temporary release-owner risk acceptance for the existing production exposure while restoring delivery of independently verified fixes. On 2026-10-03 KST, all six last-successful production image digests still report this exact High identity and Debian has no fixed gcc-14 package. The upstream fix changes the PBDS binary_heap erase_if header; absence of headers or direct calls does not prove prebuilt dependencies unreachable. Academy exploitability remains unknown, including crash or memory-corruption risk. This is not a false-positive or remediation claim. Accept only this exact identity until 2026-10-09 UTC, with no automatic renewal, no Critical acceptance and no unreviewed High identity. Every candidate still requires six fresh completed scans, isolated development/preprod, compatible migration, health-gated replacement and runtime/affected-flow verification. Owner and source evidence: docs/operations/container-image-security.md.

Individually reviewed temporary release-owner acceptance after official candidate run37091442044 detected this additional identity. Refreshed COMPLETE scans at 2026-10-03 03:24 UTC show the identical two GCC High identities in all six last-successful production digests and all six new candidates, with no Critical finding. Debian gcc-14 remains unfixed. Upstream commit59d235ffa5a69231eb42e5290d52dc8c90d28b7a describes aligned-new integer overflow and distinguishes the POSIX allocation path. Each final image package installation now runs the system libstdc++ normal-allocation and nine overflow-rejection oracle, or explicitly reports the system package absent; any installed-library failure stops the build. This is not a package remediation or universal non-reachability claim: statically linked and wheel-vendored implementations are outside that oracle and application exploitability remains unproven. The unchanged running exposure and delayed application/security fixes justify this exact-version acceptance only through 2026-10-09 UTC, with no automatic renewal, no Critical or unreviewed High acceptance, and all scan/development/preprod/continuity gates retained. Owner and evidence: docs/operations/container-image-security.md.
